mealAnalysis.guidance_message: This appears to be a mixed fruit salad, which contains naturally occurring sugars that can raise blood sugar levels in someone with diabetes, though the fiber content may moderate the response somewhat. It is best to avoid or strictly limit this meal, opting for a smaller portion paired with unsweetened yogurt or higher-fiber whole fruit choices instead.
mealAnalysis.meal_description: A small bowl of mixed fresh fruit, appearing to include banana, strawberry, pear, and apple pieces.
